cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a convenience store — bright shelves of snacks, a register counter, a hot-food warmer and a glowing drink fridge
cuts.scene: she is the store manager sitting upright on a stool behind the register, thinking over the night's restocking
cuts.outfit: a convenience store clerk look fitted to her body — a fitted short-sleeved store shirt tied at the waist and a short skirt, bare legs, a triple-stripe name tag
